reply_text: Kwame, the only discount figures posted in #coastal-team are from November 2025. On 17 Nov, Bettina first wrote 12%, then corrected it the same afternoon to **10%**, saying the 12% came from a misread draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. The 10% is the latest figure in the channel, but it's almost a year old, so I can't confirm it's still the current rate. For the renewal brief, check the current figure with June on the deal desk before you cite it.
